name: Preserve a source-addressed dramatic score through typed MIDI2 transport
source: synthetic source-addressed score fixture; original 15-page work is private and not bundled
claimBoundary: reusable kit projection only; not an admitted Reframe scenario, released instrument, or hardware MIDI2
purpose: Maintain all authored stage, lighting, sound, voice and source-passage relationships while emitting existing local MIDI2 UMP only for explicitly proposed sonification.

operations.transport: MIDI2 64-bit UMP control-change, existing backplane vocabulary

preconditions: known source identity and SHA-256 are supplied by host
original source text remains under Press or host Store authority
source passage order and unique cue identities are complete and stable
host selects corpus and scene; kit never chooses Store, network, peer or credentials
no emission claims live hardware or automatic timing

actors.kit: validates and projects source-only semantic index and optional sonic MIDI CC events
actors.host: selects source, Store, permission and the existing IDL instrument operation
actors.monitor: Reframe Swift MIDI2 Monitor owns actual observed transport lifecycle; not this kit
actors.source: Fountain Press retains document authorship and source addresses

steps.action: decode source-addressed projection and confirm source identity/version/digest
steps.terminal: all original event identities and cue links accounted for; private text excluded from output

steps.action: produce deterministic bounded native document-put request candidates
steps.terminal: every source-only event indexed, repeat projection creates identical IDs and chunk hashes

steps.action: produce existing stage/midi.events.put request candidates from mapped SD cues only
steps.terminal: each musical transport packet has exactly two valid 32-bit UMP words, original cue/source identity, and no inferred note, tempo or timing

steps.action: reject duplicate, stale, malformed, mixed-origin or out-of-range source/mapping inputs
steps.terminal: refused before effects or partial artifact promotion
exact same document identifiers, payload digests, UMP words and semantic order

steps.action: host may discard candidate requests without sending
steps.terminal: no Store, MIDI2, Csound or hardware effects caused by kit creation

terminalPredicates.positive: source event count, 32 cue identities in original scenario, 29 cue passages, 16 optional sonification packet proposals, deterministic typed request boundaries
terminalPredicates.negative: source revision mismatch, invalid digest, cue duplication, unknown controller, LX-only cue sonification, nonfinite mapping, invented timing, oversized request, replay drift
terminalPredicates.evidence: Swift unit tests, original score private fixture QA, artifact hashes, exact IDL topic strings
terminalPredicates.notEstablished: Reframe runtime invocation, Swift Monitor peer discovery, FountainStore terminal receipt, AX/window evidence, FCIS-KIT release, MIDI-CI, physical MIDI2

hostAcceptanceRequired: released kit artifact pinned by version and digest
Reframe scenario YAML plus checked JSON projection under LiveScenarios
source authority admitted in managed FountainStore
host invokes IDL topics using current transport and managed Store
same-run Swift Monitor, Store, AX and independent window-ID evidence
